label: Merchant boarding
openQuestions: BRD-05: Source of the HATEOAS sign link at submission time is not fully documented
BRD-07/BRD-08: UAT pricing intent ids and approved fee values come from Payroc
BRD-12: Whether UAT permits duplicate taxId testing is unconfirmed

scenarios.title: Create merchant platform
scenarios.objective: Verify a complete boarding submission is accepted and ids are persisted.
steps: Build the body with business, processingAccounts (owners, processing, funding, pricing, signature, addendums [] if none).
POST /v1/merchant-platforms with a fresh Idempotency-Key.
Persist merchantPlatformId and each processingAccountId.
scenarios.expected: 201 with merchantPlatformId, processingAccounts[].processingAccountId and status entered or pending.
scenarios.testData: Use test business/owner data only; UAT ids are plain integers (opaque).
scenarios.pitfalls: Parsing ids against a PREFIX-XXXX pattern; amounts must be cents; volumeBreakdown must sum to 100.

scenarios.title: Owners: one control prong and a different authorized signatory
scenarios.objective: Verify ownership rules are met and no single owner holds both flags.
steps: Submit with two owners: one isControlProng true, a different isAuthorizedSignatory true.
Submit a variant where one owner has both flags set (expect rejection).
scenarios.expected: Valid split returns 201. Both-flags variant returns 400 with errors[].parameter naming the owner relationship.

scenarios.title: Validation errors surfaced from errors[]
scenarios.objective: Verify partner maps 400 errors[].parameter to request fields.
steps: Submit an invalid body (e.g. volumeBreakdown not summing to 100, or digit-less phone).
Show the operator/log displaying each errors[].parameter and message.
Correct and resubmit with a fresh Idempotency-Key.
scenarios.expected: 400 problem-details with errors[] items (parameter, detail, message); corrected resubmission with new key returns 201.

scenarios.title: Missing Idempotency-Key rejected
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner always sends Idempotency-Key.
steps: POST a boarding request without the header (certification only).

scenarios.title: Direct-link signature
scenarios.objective: Verify signature type requestedViaDirectLink with a HATEOAS link and merchant redirect.
steps: Submit signature {type: requestedViaDirectLink, link} per the HATEOAS link.
Retrieve the sign link and redirect the merchant.
scenarios.expected: 201; sign link available; processingAccount.signature.signed received after signing.
scenarios.testData: Where the initial link object comes from is not fully documented in the skill.

scenarios.title: Email signature and reminder
scenarios.objective: Verify requestedViaEmail and optional pricingAgreement reminder.
steps: Board with signature.type requestedViaEmail.
POST /v1/processing-accounts/{id}/reminders {type: pricingAgreement}.
scenarios.expected: Reminder returns 201 with reminderId; 409 if already signed.

scenarios.title: Pricing intent id assigned at boarding
scenarios.objective: Verify an environment-correct pricingIntentId is used and the intent is active.
steps: Obtain an active pricingIntentId for UAT (Payroc-provided or created below).
Board with pricing {type: intent, pricingIntentId}.
scenarios.expected: Accepted with 201; no UAT intent ids hard-coded for production.
scenarios.testData: Payroc provides intent ids; confirm UAT id with Payroc.

scenarios.title: Create and read a pricing intent
scenarios.objective: Verify partner-managed pricing templates are created in pendingReview and read back.
steps: POST /v1/pricing-intents with key, country US, version 5.2, base, processor, gateway.
GET /v1/pricing-intents/{id} and confirm status.
scenarios.expected: 201 with id and status pendingReview; usable only once active.
scenarios.testData: Fee values are commercially negotiated; use values agreed with Payroc.
scenarios.pitfalls: base fields must be numeric (0), not null; amounts in cents.

scenarios.title: Add a processing account to an existing platform
scenarios.objective: Verify an additional MID is created via the platform sub-resource.
steps: POST /v1/merchant-platforms/{merchantPlatformId}/processing-accounts with a single account object (no wrapper).
Read back via GET /v1/processing-accounts/{id}.
scenarios.pitfalls: Do not wrap the body like Create Merchant Platform.

scenarios.title: Attachment upload and status
scenarios.objective: Verify multipart upload and uploadStatus read-back.
steps: POST multipart/form-data with attachment (JSON part, type from enum) and file (binary) to /v1/processing-accounts/{id}/attachments.
GET /v1/attachments/{attachmentId} and read uploadStatus.
scenarios.expected: 201 with attachmentId and uploadStatus pending; later accepted or rejected.
scenarios.testData: Test file under 50 MB, non-compressed allowed format (e.g. PDF).
scenarios.pitfalls: Part name is attachment (singular); do not set Content-Type application/json.

scenarios.title: Status read-back and webhook fallback
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner reads processing account/platform status as a fallback to events.
steps: GET /v1/processing-accounts/{id} and GET /v1/merchant-platforms/{id}.
Reconcile status against the last processingAccount.status.changed event.
scenarios.expected: 200 with current status matching partner records.

scenarios.title: Duplicate merchant (409) handled
scenarios.objective: Verify partner retrieves the existing record on resourceAlreadyExists/taxIdInUse and checks whether an idempotent first POST succeeded.
steps: Resubmit boarding for an already-boarded Tax ID (certification only).
scenarios.expected: 409; partner retrieves existing platform instead of re-POSTing.
